title: Beef Barbacoa Tacos
description: A flavorful and spicy beef barbacoa recipe served in tacos, perfect for a gluten-free dinner.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the beef chunks and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced chipotle peppers, cumin, coriander, and lime juice to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the browned beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the beef is tender, about 2 1/2 hours.
Shred the beef with two forks and stir in chopped cilantro.
Serve the beef barbacoa in tacos with your favorite toppings.
